text:
Jin L: Quick report from onboarding run: sampleapp streaming client prints truncated JSON and then throws "SyntaxError: Unexpected token "

Priya M: can you paste the raw bytes or a hexdump?

Jin L: pasted below (hexdump of last 3 writes):
```
00000000  64 61 74 61 3a 20 7b 22  69 64 22 3a 22 6d 73 67  |data: {"id":"msg|
00000010  31 22 2c 22 63 68 75 6e  6b 22 3a 22 48 65 6c 6c  |1","chunk":"Hell|
00000020  6f 5c 6e 5c 72 5c 6e 64  61 74 61 3a 20 7b 22 69  |o\n\r\ndata: {"i|
00000030  64 22 3a 22 6d 73 67 31  22 2c 22 63 68 75 6e 6b  |d":"msg1","chunk|
00000040  22 3a 22 6f 21 22 5c 72  5c 6e 0a 0a               |":"o!"\r\n\n|
```
note the "\r\n" sequences embedded right between data frames. client output: "{\"id\":\"msg1\",\"chunk\":\"Hell" then stops, parser waits and then error.

Evan T: likely the edge proxy is converting h2->h1 and inserting CRLFs for comment lines or reformatting. when chunk coalescing happens the middle of an event can contain CR or CRLF that our SSE reassembler treats as delimiter only if followed by LF, otherwise it can break state.

Priya M: interesting. iirc older SSE comment keepalives use a single \r or \n with a leading ":" comment token. proxies sometimes normalise to CRLF. if CR appears alone our finite state machine might think it's a line terminator and split in the wrong place.

Jin L: repro steps (local):
```
# create a tiny proxy that forces CRLF and coalesces writes
python3 -m http.server 8081 &
# run a tiny node proxy that reads h2 and writes h1 with forced \r\n between writes (gist in thread)
node tools/h2-to-h1-proxy.js --force-crlf --coalesce
node sampleapp/stream-demo.js --url http://localhost:8080/stream
```
observed: partial token output, then `SyntaxError` after ~7s, no reconnect attempted.

Evan T: short term we should: 1) make the reassembler treat bare CR as equivalent to LF when deciding event/field breaks, 2) ensure `data:` payload assembly ignores isolated CR or trailing CR before LF when inside a value. i'll draft patch.

Priya M: and add an automated test in sampleapp/minirepro that sends `data:` fragments split with various separators: `\n\n`, `\r\n\r\n`, `\n:\r\n`, `\r`, and with gzip off/on. CI should run it on PRs.

Jin L: filing SDK ticket DXP-4121 and adding the repro gist to the issue. i'll also update onboarding doc with a short note: "If you see partial JSON + SyntaxError on slow/modern proxies, try running with a proxy shim or disable h2->h1 conversion."

deploy-bot: ci/sampleapp-minirepro #88 queued (branch: jin/crlf-tolerant-reasm) :truck:

Evan T: one more UX note: the node sampleapp should surface the raw last-chunk hex on error to help users file issues faster. small PR coming.

Priya M: nice; this was a tricky one to find via manual testing. once tests land we should add it to onboarding checklist.

Jin L: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now, follow-up in DXP-4121.
